issue.title: Validate Solana transaction instructions and wallet accounts
issue.description:
## Queue Disposition — 2026-10-26

Removed from [FESOL-87](<https://linear.app/gmx-io/issue/FESOL-87>) and tracked under source [FESOL-56](<https://linear.app/gmx-io/issue/FESOL-56>) in Backlog. This is scope/readiness triage, not completion or cancellation.

The current description does not yet fix a complete versioned instruction allowlist, account constraints and positive/negative fixtures. It is not an admitted ready slice.

## Required Next Step / Readmission Gate

Before requesting readmission: pin the actual supported program/IDL and currently fixed WASM ABI; write the exact instruction/account rule table, including versioned messages, LUT resolution, payer/owner/receiver/rent receiver and rejection of unknown or truncated inputs. Narrow acceptance to a deterministic offline validator. Use [FESOL-95](<https://linear.app/gmx-io/issue/FESOL-95>) for builder-produced positive fixtures and mutate each required account/instruction for rejection tests; do not make 95 depend back on 93. Simulation, SOL sufficiency, trading flags, wallet signing and broadcast stay in [FESOL-56](<https://linear.app/gmx-io/issue/FESOL-56>). Confirm no newly overlapping PR exists.

## Retained Scope and Acceptance

The original scope below is retained for traceability. The readiness decision above supersedes any older claim that this is ready to start independently.

## Context

Split from [FESOL-56](<https://linear.app/gmx-io/issue/FESOL-56>) originally grouped under [FESOL-87](https://linear.app/gmx-io/issue/FESOL-87/issues-split-summary) (removed from that queue on 2026-10-26). Extract deterministic transaction validation from wallet signing and RPC simulation, so rejection rules can be implemented before end-to-end sending.

This follows the release-based integration: gmx-api provides normalized data to the existing GMX shared state and components. GMTrade-labelled work and the old nightly implementation are out of scope. Follow the existing `gmx-solana` guidance.

## Scope

* Decode every instruction, including versioned messages with supplied lookup-table accounts.
* Allow only the order and setup instructions specified by [FESOL-56](https://linear.app/gmx-io/issue/FESOL-56/build-check-and-send-solana-order-transactions-with-the-gmsol-sdk), SOL wrapping and Compute Budget; reject unexpected instructions, including unexpected gmsol instructions.
* Validate the expected wallet as fee payer, owner and receiver wherever required by the instruction contract. Fail clearly when required lookup data cannot be resolved.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Tests accept supported instruction fixtures and reject unexpected programs, unexpected gmsol instructions and mismatched wallet accounts.
- [ ] Resolved lookup-table addresses are checked rather than skipped.
- [ ] The validator takes explicit transaction, wallet and lookup inputs and does not require a connected wallet.

## Dependencies and Related Work

This historical readiness claim is superseded by the disposition above. Use confirmed instruction layouts and explicit fixtures.

Related work: [FESOL-56](<https://linear.app/gmx-io/issue/FESOL-56>), [FESOL-49](<https://linear.app/gmx-io/issue/FESOL-49>), [FESOL-55](<https://linear.app/gmx-io/issue/FESOL-55>), [FESOL-57](<https://linear.app/gmx-io/issue/FESOL-57>).

## Recommended Implementation Path

Define supported instruction/account rules, add decoder fixtures, then implement the validator. Wire it before every signature during [FESOL-56](https://linear.app/gmx-io/issue/FESOL-56/build-check-and-send-solana-order-transactions-with-the-gmsol-sdk) integration.

## Remaining in the Original Issue

RPC simulation, SOL sufficiency checks, fresh trading-flag enforcement and actual wallet/send flows stay in [FESOL-56](https://linear.app/gmx-io/issue/FESOL-56/build-check-and-send-solana-order-transactions-with-the-gmsol-sdk). Completing this subissue does not close [FESOL-56](<https://linear.app/gmx-io/issue/FESOL-56>).
